_comment: Lenient decode of a reported MessageContent (messaging.v1; moderation.v1 ReportContentRequest.message_payload). Field 1 (text) and field 2 (shared_post_id) are taken only with the length-delimited wire type, the last occurrence winning; every other field or wire type is skipped; invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD; want_wire_ok is false only for bytes that are not well-formed protobuf. Go: backend/internal/moderation/decode_vectors_test.go. Dart: app/test/features/messages/domain/e2ee/message_content_codec_test.dart runs the same rows (so what the reporter sees is what the moderator gets). Expected strings are after the U+FFFD replacement; want_shared_post_id is before the server's 19-digit check.

cases.name: valid text, shared post and report key
invalid UTF-8 in shared post id
text as a varint is skipped
valid text then a truncated unknown field
tag above 32 bits (Dart reads field 1, field number beyond 2^29-1)
10-byte varint ending in 0x02 in an unknown varint field
field 1 as a start/end group is skipped
shared post id before the text
two invalid bytes, one replacement each
cases.note: Go replaces each byte utf8.DecodeRuneInString rejects (width 1). Settled 2026-11-19: the Dart decoder replaces byte by byte like Go.

cases.name: encoded surrogate ED A0 80
cases.note: ED only takes 80-9F as its second byte, so each of the three bytes is rejected alone. Settled 2026-11-19: the Dart decoder replaces byte by byte like Go.

cases.name: truncated 3-byte sequence E2 82 then A
cases.note: Go rejects E2 and 82 one byte at a time (2 replacements); a decoder that replaces the maximal subpart E2 82 as one sequence (WHATWG) gives 1. Settled 2026-11-19: the Dart decoder replaces byte by byte like Go.
